meaning_fixes.reason: Source line (romaji: ryuushi fi-rudo wo toppa shinai to ta-getto wa gekiha dekinai kedo, ima made no houhou de kaijo suru no wa muzukashii) has no direct object for the disable/release verb (kaijo suru); it pairs with the particle field just breached, not the target (confirmed by the next two rows, which describe using an all-out barrage to eliminate the field weapon, not the target). The old English 'disable it' reads with 'it' = target (nearest antecedent), the wrong referent (and an odd verb for a target, which you 'take down' rather than 'disable'); reworded to name the field explicitly. Stayed at 128 visible chars, same tag set/order, ASCII.
